propositions: rebar-debug skill currently closes bug tickets without recording the originating ticket in the caused_by relation, causing defect escape rates to be unmeasurable

the automatic blame fallback charges defects to whoever wrote most of the file rather than who introduced the defect, and cannot detect cases where the fix site differs from cause site (unmet obligations, missed consumer updates)
the skill must identify the introducing ticket by blaming implicated lines, walking carrier commits, and recovering the ticket from commit trailers before RCA writeback

caused_by must be explicitly supplied via --caused-by flag on bug close even if the link was previously recorded via rebar link, to prevent duplicate edges from unconditional fallback blame derivation
worktree bootstrap must use make worktree name=<branch> instead of bare git worktree add to provision the venv, and all commands must run with worktree venv first on PATH to satisfy pre-commit hooks
